development_exposed: yes - batch1; HF/IRC-extrap test; V0/field-calibration case
quantity: Tavg: CFD monitor 'Average chip surface temperature' (area-averaged by the CFD solver)

history.note: CFD monitor; the forecaster's input history (30 s window ending at the origin)

target_rule: target_index = origin_index + 2*h (dt = 0.5 s); target_time = origin_time + h

phases.criterion: f(t) = (Tavg_CFD(t) - Tavg_CFD(0.5 s)) / (Tavg_CFD(899.5 s) - Tavg_CFD(0.5 s)); fast heating f < 0.90, transition 0.90 <= f < 0.99, near steady f >= 0.99 (evaluated at the origin time; CFD reference only, post-hoc, independent of model errors). Representative origin = middle origin of each phase.

variants.H0: GRU encoder (1 layer, 32 units) over 30 s history [Tavg, Tf, Q, flow, relative time]; two latent modes X1, X2 stepped 1 s by an MLP; output Tavg = w X1 + (1-w) X2 (degC). Loss: data + origin.
variants.H1: Same network as H0; loss adds a fixed two-mode R2 physics residual (tau1, tau2, Gamma, w fixed from the R2 fit on the 7 training runs), lambda_phys = 0.01.
variants.H2: Same as H1 but tau1, tau2, Gamma, w are learned jointly (global, initialised at R2), lambda_phys = 0.01.
variants.R2_KF_W: Two-mode R2 ODE + Kalman filter over the same 30 s window; future Tf held at Tf(t0) (causal).

model.inputs: last 30 s of [Tavg monitor, Tf monitor, Q, flow]; Q, flow and Tf held at their origin value (no future information); no absolute time
model.output: Tavg at origin + h, h = 1..60 s (one trajectory per origin)
model.seed_note: Seed variability = +-1 SD (ddof=1) across 3 training runs (seeds 0,1,2). Not a confidence interval.

baselines.R2_KF_W: Two-mode lumped thermal model + Kalman filter on the same 30 s window
baselines.TREND: Linear trend over the last 30 s

metric_definition: Over the 156 main origins t_k = 60.5..835.5 s (stride 5 s, overlapping, not independent); error = forecast - CFD Tavg at t_k + h.
